frontend: shared pretrained CNN Conv-BN-ReLU-pool widths 16/32/128, GAP128; classifier discarded and all feature parameters/buffers frozen
encoding: 128 nonnegative GAP channels in fixed row-major 16x8 grid; each repeated into 14x28 cell; 224x224 amplitude normalized to unit L2 power
input_normalization: same train-only channel mean/std saved in the frozen CNN checkpoint
loss: NLL of normalized optical detector energies; no electronic logits or output fusion
selection: maximum validation accuracy, then minimum validation NLL, then earlier epoch
augmentation: same per-epoch horizontal flip on input images before shared CNN, no ColorJitter
oeo: after each propagated layer: intensity -> spatial mean normalization -> u/(1+u) -> unit-power amplitude, zero phase
